title: M5 comment on the personal rules
description: Structured reply of prompt 5b (cap4 4.3.5). The platform shows only `message`; the other fields feed the log (Tabella 10) and the G3 check against the ids of {{missed_clues}}. All fields required, nullable values explicit (strict structured-output modes).

message.description: Comment shown to the user: max 3 sentences, max 1 open question, never a ready-made rule.

covered_clue_ids.description: Ids from block 3 covered by at least one of the user's rules.

focus_clue_id.description: Id from block 3 of the uncovered cue the question is about, or null.

generic_rule.description: True if at least one rule only repeats a module 3 guideline without a concrete situation.
